blocks.text: Vongrasig is devoted to create a tender and fancy outdoor living environment for every customer. Relaxing in the sunny day outside with friends, this Vongrasig Outdoor 5 Piece Rattan Sectional Seating Group is the one that you'll want to relax in. Stylish and perfect for any outdoor space including yards, patios, gardens, porches or indoors if you want. Each piece in this set is founded on a sturdy steel inner frame wrapped in tightly woven PE wicker in a rich dark coffee hue. Striking clean-lined contemporary silhouettes is lined with comfy foam core cushions for comfort and support, while the matching coffee table features an easy-to-clean glass tabletop – perfect for holding a couple of drinks as you lounge in the sun. Don’t hesitate! You won’t regret to buy this set.
1.Please refer to size description before purchase to avoid unnecessary trouble
2.Color discrepancies may occur between this product and your monitor
3.Please remove your cushions in rainy days since the inner sponge is Not Water Proof
4. Please do not expose the set to a burning sun and cover the wicker sofa when you are not in use to ensure a long-lasting product life
5. Assembly Advice: Please do not tighten all the screws until all the holes are aligned
6. If there is any part missing/damaged or dissatisfaction when you receive, please feel free to contact us. We have a professional after-sales team to solve your problem

items.label: Sturdy Patio Furniture
items.value: The outdoor furniture set is made of solid powder coated steel frame, rustproof and sturdy; hand-woven resin wicker offers high tensile strength, water resistance, which is strong enough to withstand all-weather variations for long service life.

items.label: Comfortable Outdoor Couch
items.value: Comes with 2.9 inch thick lofty sponge padded cushions, the modern patio sectional couch providing with extraordinary comfort while relaxing in your leisure time, suitable for entertaining your neighbors or friends.

items.label: Easy Cleaning and Maintain
items.value: Our patio conversation set features a water proof wicker and removable tempered glass top for the coffee table, easy for wipe cleaning; zippered cushion covers are made of superior fabric, fade resistant, water spill repellent and washable.

items.label: Convertible Patio Set
items.value: Each part of this 3 piece patio furniture could be used separately, easily allowing to be combined into different configurations according to your needs. Ideal for outdoor patio, porch, backyard, balcony, garden and poolside.

items.label: Customer Service
items.value: Free replacement for damaged and defective items and missing accessories. If any problem, please feel free to contact us: Login to your amazon account >choose "Your orders"> find the order ID > click "Contact seller".
